raise_LoggedError: raise a LoggedError exception with a custom message for agent logging
raise_AgentError: raise an AgentError exception when the agent encounters a general error
raise_ToolError: raise a ToolError exception when a tool call fails during execution
raise_WebError: raise a WebError exception when web browsing fails during agent execution
raise_FatalError: raise a FatalError exception to signal task failure and stop the agent
